title: Doubt, Jealousy, and Projection: Psychological Verbs and Case Government

sections.title: Spatial Metaphors of the Mind
sections.content: Hungarian conceptualizes psychological processes through vivid spatial preverbs and case suffixes. Confronting a fear or reality requires szembenéz valamivel ('looks in the eye / confronts sth with -val/-vel'). Identifying with a role or feeling uses azonosul valamivel ('becomes identical with / identifies with -val/-vel'). Plunging into thoughts or dreams requires belemerül valamibe ('plunges into / becomes immersed in -ba/-be').

sections.title: Projection and Repression (kivetít valamire, elfojt valamit)
sections.content: In the vocabulary of the Budapest School of psychoanalysis and modernist literature, kivetít valamit valakire ('projects something onto someone', sublative -ra/-re) describes attributing one's own unconscious anxieties to another person, while elfojt valamit ('represses / suppresses something', accusative -t) describes pushing unacceptable impulses out of awareness. Notice how preverbs separate when another element occupies the focus slot: Saját bizonytalanságát vetítette ki a feleségére ('It was his own insecurity that he projected onto his wife').

sections.title: High-Frequency B2 Psychological Case Frames
rows: Bátran szembenézett a múltbeli kudarcaival. (He bravely confronted his past failures.)
Az olvasó könnyen azonosul a regény vívódó hősével. (The reader easily identifies with the novel's conflicted hero.)
Tehetetlenül belemerült a saját kínzó gondolataiba. (He helplessly plunged into his own tormenting thoughts.)
A féltékeny ember a saját félelmeit vetíti ki a másikra. (A jealous person projects his own fears onto the other.)

items.spanish: Eljött az ideje, hogy őszintén szembenézzünk az elfojtott indulatokkal.
items.english: The time has come for us to honestly confront the repressed emotions.

items.spanish: Minél mélyebben belemerült az álomfejtésbe, annál több összefüggést fedezett fel.
items.english: The more deeply he immersed himself in dream interpretation, the more connections he discovered.

items.spanish: Störr kapitány rájött, hogy a saját gyanakvását vetítette ki a feleségére.
items.english: Captain Störr realized that he had projected his own suspicion onto his wife.

items.spanish: A színész annyira azonosult a tragikus szereppel, hogy még az előadás után is remegett a hangja.
items.english: The actor identified so deeply with the tragic role that his voice trembled even after the performance.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: When linking 'szembenéz' or 'azonosul' to a subordinate 'hogy'-clause, use the instrumental cataphoric pronoun 'azzal': 'Szembenézett azzal, hogy nem ismerheti ki teljesen a másikat.'
